genericProblem: A governed generator changed one or more generated artifacts after a package baseline without a pre/post receipt edge from the package baseline hash to the final hash.
searchedSurfaces: U04 package baseline and delta graph
all U04 hook receipt events for the four generated outputs
IntelliJ LocalHistory and VFS content cache

counterexamples.case: Unreceipted generated output is present after baseline
counterexamples.evidence: validate-delta-receipts fails with INCREMENTAL_RECEIPT_CHAIN_MISSING for the generated file.
baseline addendum accepts only non-baselined owner-scope files and cannot replace an existing U04 baseline entry.

findings.finding: The four generated outputs lacked a complete U04 baseline-to-final receipt graph; TS operations-edge.ts additionally had a historic discontinuity 1160…e29db to f0c9…dcc45.

preventionDispositions.reason: The existing control fail-closedly rejects the discontinuity; P3-C performs a truthful baseline restoration and pre-to-post generator replay rather than widening recovery policy.

historicalTsBaseline.verification: Read-only raw-LZ4 decode of 87322 bytes matched the U04 baseline hash.

lawfulRecovery.replay: Restore all four verified baseline bytes, record a four-path pre-hook, regenerate from current authoritative source, record post-hook, then require receipt equality and generator check.
